digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center reconciler transport adapter
propositions: The Data Center Jira backend needs a transport built on pycontribs/jira satisfying TicketTransport, SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, and SupportsAbsenceProbe, confined to an opt-in [jira-datacenter] extra and imported lazily so import rebar stays dependency-free.

Authentication uses a Personal Access Token read env-only from JIRA_PAT passed as token_auth, with url and project from typed config, and a malformed config must fail loudly with ConfigError rather than degrading to env-only.

Every transport method must return rebar's raw payload shapes ({key, fields}) that existing mappers consume rather than leaking jira.Issue objects, enforced by the shared verified-fake shape contract across Cloud fake, Cloud real, and DC real.

Retry policy must mirror acli_rest exactly: transient connectivity faults including builtin TimeoutError retried with 2s/5s backoff, HTTP errors never retried, and unknown assignees raise BackendAssigneeNotFoundError on the apply path.
The DC backend must self-register via an import in adapters/__init__.py so select_backend('jira-datacenter') resolves rather than raising BackendRegistryError at an operator's first run.

TLS verification must never be disabled: a non-https base_url is rejected with a ConfigError naming cleartext risk unless allow_insecure is set, allow_insecure affects only the URL scheme check, and ca_bundle configures internal CAs; resolved_statuses configures the absence-probe resolved set defaulting to {Resolved, Done, Cancelled}.
